prompt:
Summarize database sharding strategies. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use any words with more than 4 letters. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Format as an HTML unordered list (
  • ...
).
evaluation_criteria:
Short Word Limit: 0-5 (Evaluates strict adherence to <= 4 letter words)
Html Formatting: 0-5 (Evaluates valid HTML tags)
response_text:
```html
  • Split big data into smol parts.
  • Use keys like IDs or locs for split.
  • Range shard: split by num ranges (e.g., 1-100, 101-200).
  • Hash shard: use hash funcs to pick shards.
  • Dir shard: split by data type (e.g., users, logs).
  • Combo shard: mix ways (e.g., hash + dir).
  • Add proxies to route reqs to right shard.
  • Keep same data near each other.
  • Add rebal to move data if shards grow.
  • Use sync or async for data syncs.
  • Pick shard count by load and size.
  • Test failover for shard down.
```
